falsifiable_hypothesis: The verified two-range control calibrator assumes an affine relation between plate dynamic range and the remaining common B residual. Assay response can bend with overall dynamic range, while the effect of a p1-vs-p2 control imbalance should change target predictions in proportion to the fixed fraction of that target's 64-well acquisition lying on each plate. A quadratic mean-range term plus one plate-imbalance interaction tests those two physical effects without target-specific parameter fitting.
base_prediction_rule: Reproduce paid_cardinality_separate_local_pooling from the same two_dose_full_negative_A_extension base. Do not stack the comparator prediction itself.
standard_control_feature_rule: Use the same authenticated public-workbook DMSO/BzCl p1/p2 dynamic-range features as standard_control_range_calibration. Let a=p1_logrange, b=p2_logrange, m=(a+b)/2 and d=(a-b)/2. The common control basis is exactly [m,d,m^2]. Fit patient-balanced affine ridge with lambda=PRIOR times the mean fitting-feature energy, PRIOR=0.125.
plate_interaction_rule: For every fitting-only acquisition plan and target j, define imbalance_j=(number of its selected B-orientation wells on p1 minus number on p2)/its selected-well count. Cross-fit the common [m,d,m^2] control model over the K=3 inner patient folds and subtract it from the twice-cross-fitted leftover B residual matrix. Define X_ij=imbalance_j*(p1_logrange_i-p2_logrange_i). Fit one shared scalar beta across all samples and 24 targets with equal-patient/equal-target weights and ridge denominator factor (1+PRIOR). At deployment add PRIOR*beta*X_ij. The extra PRIOR factor is the frozen conservative deployment strength.
upstream_residual_rule: Reproduce the verified global mean/std/min/max common model, min/max cardinality contrast model, and shared/two-dose/three-dose local models exactly, including two-stage cross-fitting and LOCAL_STRENGTH=2*PRIOR=0.25.
budget_statement: Adds zero treatment wells and keeps the 64-treatment-well 32/32 plan unchanged. It requires the same standard DMSO/BzCl controls already declared by the comparator.
regularization_rationale: No feature menu, lambda search, target routing, fold rescue, protected data, or outer-held fitting enters canonical replay. The family was selected after development diagnostics and therefore remains repeated adaptive development rather than independent validation.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions

binding_note: This v2 supersedes an invalidated pre-run freeze whose base_predictions hash was bound to the comparator layer instead of the protocol-required two_dose_full_negative_A_extension base. No v1 candidate output was created.
